newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 8.3 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 8.3 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton production from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop reached 8.335 million 375-lb bales by February 15 compared to 9.481 million in the year-ago period, the Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association (PCGA) said on Tuesday.

It said ginners had sold 6.531 million bales to textile mills, against 6.994 million in the year-ago period, and 5,400 bales to exporters compared to 1.128 million last year. Some 1.798 million bales remained unsold at ginneries.
A PCGA official said total production was likely to reach 8.7 million bales, compared to a target of 10 million and a 1995/96 crop of 9.94 million.
